population.text: Key inclusion criteria for participant eligibility were adults who initiated oral antibiotic treatment in the ambulatory setting, consisting of 1 or 2 antibiotics (ie, broad-spectrum penicillins, cephalosporins, quinolones, and tetracyclines) with a total duration of 5 to 10 days.

notes: The source agrees with all served counts: 26/282 for the studied probiotic mix and 69/273 for placebo. These are participants with AAD, not episodes, in the efficacy analysis (described as a modified intention-to-treat population). Randomised totals were 285 and 279; 3 and 6 participants, respectively, discontinued early without efficacy data and were excluded. AAD was defined as at least 3 loose or liquid stools over 24 hours; the primary outcome counted participants experiencing at least 1 day of diarrhea.
